trigger: a later change adds a cause field while an MCP client validates get_rbac_enforcement results against the published outputSchema
summary: The new note told all clients to ignore unrecognised fields, but the MCP outputSchema for get_rbac_enforcement is closed (additionalProperties:false, mcp_server.cpp ~4515), so the sentence was not true of the MCP contract. Found independently by security-guardian (MEDIUM), consistency-auditor, cpp-safety, docs-writer and cpp-expert (LOW/NICE). Fixed in b144d5607c: header, REST paragraph and MCP row now say the MCP schema is closed and must be widened in the same change.
classification_rationale: doc text disagreed with the code it describes (code wins)

trigger: a reader takes 'every cause still reads unconfirmed:true' as a constraint on a state that is not a stale view
summary: 'every cause' was broader than the field table's definition of unconfirmed (a degraded read). Reworded to 'any cause of an unconfirmed view' in all three passages. Raised by consistency-auditor, docs-writer and security-guardian.
classification_rationale: wording broader than the field it describes

trigger: a cause field is added to the MCP result without widening the schema
summary: Reviewer asked whether anything locks 'schema closed, widen with the field'. Checked: test_rbac_enforcement_read_mcp.cpp:205 validates the served structuredContent against the served outputSchema with test_json_schema_subset.hpp, whose schema_violation rejects any key not declared in properties, and :266 pins additionalProperties == false. An extra field without a schema change fails :205 and a schema change fails :266, so the statement is already locked. No change.
classification_rationale: a possibly missing lock on the closed-schema statement; the lock exists
